Name: LMGT3 Ferrari 296
Author: Redadeg (lmu-dashboards.com)
Description: Converted for the FX Pro by FX Unleashed from Redadeg's SimHub dash "LMGT3 Ferrari 296" (https://lmu-dashboards.com). Parts flip on their own, as in the original: the tyres, pressures or temperatures (Next page 1); the lap time panel: last lap, lap time, predicted, overall best, personal best (Next page 2); the two energy-low warnings are put away with Next page 3 and 4. Runs best with the screen's RAM drive (Wheel tab).
